decisions.reason: Changing the Block prize counts and draw intervals does not alter the $5 code-used referral commission.
The source changes prize amounts, winner counts, and draw intervals but does not resolve or modify prize delivery and claim behavior.
Message 158 does not change or remove Aave yield integration; the later statement at message 159 cannot be propagated from this source Event.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates both Small and Big Block prize descriptions to the new counts and intervals.
The number and frequency of prizes change, but ticket-weighted Chainlink VRF winner selection remains valid unchanged.
The existing MODIFY captures the new winner count and interval but leaves the obsolete approximate-interval flag true even though the source specifies exactly every 10,000 sales.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just thought of something.... I believe we should adjust the block prizes to
- Small = 1 x $500 every 100 sales.
- Big = 1 x $10,000 every 10,000 sales.

The same net $ amount would still be given away, but this would create a smoother, cleaner, clearer, and more consistent flow of winners

decisions.reason: The existing message-158 MODIFY fully captures the one-winner, $500-pool, exact 100-sales Small Block configuration.
Changing prize counts and draw intervals does not alter transfer of active or expired ticket state upon NFT resale.
The prize adjustment does not change referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing, display, or resale behavior.
Both Small and Big Block ticket counters remain required; changing draw counts and intervals does not necessarily alter the listed metadata fields.
The source preserves the same net prize amount and does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or active prize-pool destinations.
The Block prize adjustment does not change allocation of the $5 no-referral commission to a random existing NFT holder.
